search_results.description: The article compares email marketing platforms for 2026, evaluating ease of design, reporting, automation, templates, AI features, contact management, integrations, support, and pricing. Mailchimp is the overall pick, offering an accessible editor, AI design and writing tools, ecommerce integrations, and campaign analytics. HubSpot is recommended for customization, with CRM-based targeting, automation, testing, and AI content tools. Hostinger Reach suits small businesses seeking affordable, AI-assisted newsletters and useful delivery reports. Vertical Response targets power users with automation, analytics, surveys, landing pages, and heatmaps. Brevo is a budget option with contact-unlimited, send-based pricing, CRM, and workflows. Omnisend is tailored to ecommerce, combining email, SMS, and push campaigns. GetResponse adds chat, webinars, landing pages, and AI tools; Zoho Campaigns is a natural fit for existing Zoho users; and Campaigner supports fast-growing businesses with scalable pricing and advanced automation. The guide advises choosing based on audience size, sending limits, required automation, usability, integrations, support, and budget. Its testing considered features, interface, documentation, analytics, personalization, capacity, and trial availability.
